planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in humus-rich, consistently moist, well-drained soil in shade to partial shade; like other variegated hostas, Cathedral Windows holds its leaf pattern best out of direct afternoon sun.

directions: Plant in shade to partial shade in humus-rich, consistently moist, well-drained soil; Cathedral Windows is a variegated hosta cultivar sold by White Flower Farm, grown for its patterned foliage like other named hostas in their shade perennial collection. Keep soil evenly moist through the growing season and protect from slugs, which can disfigure the foliage if left unchecked. Divide congested clumps in early spring every several years to maintain vigor and propagate new plants.

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in humus-rich, well-drained soil in shade to partial shade; good drainage is essential for Heuchera to avoid crown rot.

directions: Plant in shade to partial shade in humus-rich, well-drained soil; Timeless Night is a dark-foliaged coral bells cultivar sold by White Flower Farm as part of their shade perennial Heuchera collection. Reliable drainage is essential for this genus to avoid crown rot, and a light winter mulch helps protect the evergreen rosettes in colder parts of its hardiness range. Divide congested clumps every few years in spring once flowering declines, to maintain vigor and propagate new plants.
